about.heading: About
bio: I design and engineer real-time 3D experiences that put restraint before spectacle: real light, real scale, honest motion.
Over the last years I have shipped interactive commerce, data visualisation and brand sites where frame time is treated as a design constraint, not an afterthought.

projects.heading: Selected work
projects.lede: Each module carries one project. Select a panel to open the case study.

items.title: Orbital Commerce
items.summary: A product configurator rendered with physically based materials and streamed KTX2 textures.
description: Real-time PBR configurator for a denim brand: fabric weave normal maps, stitch displacement and accurate indigo scattering.
Texture streaming cut initial payload by 71%, and an adaptive quality manager keeps mid-range phones above 30 fps.

items.title: Telemetry Dashboard
items.summary: GPU-instanced visualisation of 2M sensor readings with sub-millisecond picking.
description: InstancedMesh + data textures move all aggregation to the GPU; the JS thread only uploads deltas.
Accessible fallbacks render the same data as semantic tables for screen readers.

items.title: Lunar Atlas
items.summary: An interactive Moon globe built on LRO LOLA elevation data.
description: Tiled displacement maps at 16 levels of detail; terrain shading follows the real Sun position for any date.
Built with a floating-origin camera so surface flybys stay jitter-free.

items.title: Quiet Type
items.summary: A type specimen site where every reveal is tied to scroll velocity.
description: Split-text line reveals, magnetic controls and a custom cursor, all transform/opacity-only for 60 fps on low-end devices.
